summary.text: Art De La Cruz is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 12 who was appointed to the seat in 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: De La Cruz was born in Albuquerque, New Mexico, and earned a master's degree from the University of New Mexico.
De La Cruz has served as a District Two county commissioner and as a chairperson of the county commission in Bernalillo County.
De La Cruz assumed office on February 2, 2022, when he was appointed following the resignation of Brittney Barreras (D).
In the 2025-2026 session, De La Cruz chairs the Transportation, Public Works & Capital Improvements Committee.
